notes: total_sram_bytes (1060 KB) is the sum of the datasheet's own itemized breakdown: 864 KB of user SRAM (AXI-SRAM + SRAM1-4) + 192 KB of TCM RAM (64 KB ITCM + 128 KB DTCM) + 4 KB of backup SRAM. ST's own headline calls this '1 Mbyte of RAM', which is a rounded figure -- 1060 KB is itself larger than 1024 KB (1 MiB) -- so the itemized sum is used here instead, consistent with how every other profile in this catalog prefers a precise component figure over a rounded headline. total_flash_bytes (2 Mbytes) is the same datasheet's directly stated flash capacity for the 'xI' devices. st.com blocks automated fetches of this PDF directly; content verified against a SparkFun-hosted mirror of the identical document (231 pp., read in full). A newer Rev 9 exists at ST; the memory figures are silicon facts that don't move between doc revisions.
